horoscopes.intro: October 27 in the stars: Find out what’s in store for you today in our daily horoscopes for Tuesday October 27. Read the daily horoscopes for your Sun sign or rising sign (ascendant) to plan your day.

aries.text: Stand strong as the Taurus moon opposes Mercury retrograde in Scorpio and your eighth house of desire, dangling forbidden fruit in front of you. Your willpower will be MIA, whether you’re tempted by retail therapy or an ill-advised flirtation with someone unavailable. Since the messenger planet is rewinding, that temptation may arrive with a familiar face attached. Rather than gratifying your impulses, make a more constructive choice. Pulling a statement item from the back of your closet and pairing it with basics isn’t as thrilling as buying a whole new outfit. But the rave responses on social media will provide a dopamine hit!

taurus.text: Don’t assume you’re on the same wavelength with others as the Taurus moon faces off with retrograde Mercury in Scorpio and your seventh house of partnerships. Deliver a crystal-clear message and let VIPs know exactly what they can do to move along your project. Under this U-turn, repeating yourself once is wise. But if they’re going out of their way for you, spell out what’s in it for them. Zero in on a big goal and get on your grind. You have what it takes to pull it off.

gemini.text: You really can be logical and emotional at once, Twin. Tune in to your feelings without treating them like facts, especially with your ruler Mercury reversing through secretive Scorpio. A trusted confidant with no stake in this can help, particularly if the situation is hard for you to read. Fill them in and let them point you toward sensible solutions. Honor your emotions without letting them cloud your view, and you can start solving the problem. And if you’re trying to read someone’s mind, just ask what they’re thinking!

cancer.text: When you’re infatuated, it’s only natural to idealize the object of your affections. But that pedestal can prevent a real connection from forming. With Mercury’s rewind through Scorpio and your fifth house of romance, this someone could be a person you’ve already fallen for once. Stay present and savor the getting-to-know-you phase. Warning: Today it’s just as easy to start flawfinding with people you’ve known forever. Don’t spin fantasies in your head when the real person is right in front of you.

leo.text: No need to keep it strictly business today, Leo. The Taurus moon in your career corner opposes the Mercury retrograde in Scorpio and your private fourth house, blurring that line in a useful way. You shouldn’t stray into inappropriate territory, obviously. But do go deeper than quick greetings and work chatter. Ask colleagues about their life after office hours and share something about your own. Meeting potential clients? Break the ice with a low-stakes exchange before you launch into a pitch. One moment of real bonding puts everyone at ease and endears you to them.

virgo.text: Words can wound as the sensitive Taurus moon opposes backpedaling Mercury in Scorpio. Weigh what you’re about to say before you open your mouth, Virgo. With your ruling planet retrograde, the critic in you could turn a casual observation into a harsh diss. Telling the truth is fine, as long as you do it gently and with empathy for your listener. If your feelings are overwhelming, stay quiet for now so you don’t do any damage.

libra.text: Under today’s tense faceoff between the Taurus moon and Mercury retrograde in Scorpio, you may fixate on practical matters. Perhaps you’re stressed about your budget as the holidays approach. Or you’re unsure whether certain people expect something of you that you’re not delivering. Worrying solves nothing, so think in terms of what you CAN do. Reach out to the people you’re wondering about and clear the air. And with Mercury reversing through your money house, it can’t hurt to scan your statements for a charge that shouldn’t be there.

scorpio.text: Are you ready to budge, Scorpio? With the Taurus moon opposing Mercury as it retrogrades through your sign, that stalemate you reached with someone could finally shift. Hunt for common ground and defuse the tension with a constructive talk. Do at least as much listening as talking, and step into the other person’s shoes. This review cycle is built for exactly that, and you may find you misread their POV all along. Compromise is within reach at last!

sagittarius.text: Don’t rush into action, Archer, no matter how hyped up you’re feeling. With the Taurus moon in your industrious sixth house opposing Mercury retrograde in Scorpio and your dreamy twelfth house, play with creative ideas instead of forcing them into a game plan. In this context, it’s fine to entertain even the most unconventional concepts. The sky’s the limit! You might research what your competitors are up to and use that intel as fodder for fresh brainstorms. A divine download could take your whole vision to another level.

capricorn.text: You’re under pressure, Goat, but don’t let it get to you. Naturally you want to deliver a polished presentation. But with the Taurus moon in your expressive fifth house opposing Mercury retrograde in Scorpio and your eleventh house of teamwork, a slick show is the wrong play. Relax and your personality has room to breathe, which lets you connect with people on a more genuine level. Be the consummate pro you always are AND let everyone see your perfectly imperfect side. They’ll warm to you faster than they would to the “cool as a cucumber” version.

aquarius.text: Stay focused on the finish line, Aquarius. With today’s emotionally charged Taurus moon in your domestic fourth house opposing Mercury retrograde in your tenth house of career, private dramas could bubble up and pull you off task. If you’re in charge of a mission, set the tone so everyone knows today is more work than play. Make sure each person understands their assignment, since this cycle loves a misread instruction. Draw out the quiet ones so they feel safe chiming in. Their keen observations could provide the missing link.

pisces.text: Hold yourself accountable, Fish. Everyone slips up now and then, and with the Taurus moon in your communication corner opposing Mercury retrograde in Scorpio and your ninth house of ethics, an old mistake could get dragged into the light. Your best strategy? Own it—then go a step beyond a simple apology. Tell people what you learned and what you’ll do differently going forward. You can make up for the error by showing growth. Do that, and forgiveness is practically a foregone conclusion.
